tracks.title: Open Meadow
tracks.description: An expanded edition of the original meadow theme: unhurried felt piano, broad ninth chords and a warm middle register.

tracks.title: Glasswater
tracks.description: A lilting three-beat glass-key motif reflects over open C and G voicings, with droplets answered by low piano.

tracks.title: Below the Ferns
tracks.description: A shaded, descending piano melody, muted plucked answers and close, soft D-minor string voicings.

tracks.title: Clouds in Pieces
tracks.description: Wide, gently rising felt-key intervals drift over changing G-major inversions; a high glass voice appears in the central passage.

tracks.title: Lantern Current
tracks.description: A gentle offbeat wooden pluck carries interlocking A-minor figures, answered by a warm felt-key countermelody.

tracks.title: A Place to Rest
tracks.description: Long, low piano tones and a nearly still organ-like pad leave generous space; the middle phrase opens into the upper octave.

tracks.title: Copper Dawn
tracks.description: Soft dulcimer pairs trace a rising morning figure over a brighter C-major progression, with sparse left-hand piano responses.

tracks.title: Far Hills
tracks.description: A slow three-beat piano line climbs and settles above wide G-major pads, with distant bell echoes only at phrase endings.

tracks.title: Rain on Leaves
tracks.description: Irregularly spaced glass droplets and damped wooden keys hover over a D-Dorian progression; there is no rain recording or percussion.

tracks.title: Homeward Light
tracks.description: An answering piano theme with falling sixths resolves into a spacious C-major coda, warm pads and a final distant glass response.
